brief: Modern URL shortening, multi-domain routing, and real-time analytics platform by ternis-edv.de. Focuses on high-performance redirects, SSO authentication, and a clean engineering-grade grayscale aesthetic.
criteria: Success: unmistakable monogram ownership (TEL), distinct silhouette at 16 px, pure monochrome reproducibility, seamless fit with the Tailwind v4 UI.

concepts.name: TEL Nexus
concepts.idea: An integrated monogram ligature where T forms the header crossbar, E forms the 3-tier routing ladder, and L forms the base foundation foot.
rationale: Unifies TE (Ternis) and L (Link) in a single authoritative glyph
Signature link eyelets provide distinct physical connection cues
Flawless 16 px legibility in browser tabs and toolbar extensions
100/100 production-ready SVG geometry with balanced optical margins

recommendation: TEL Nexus anchors ternis.link with commanding typographic ownership, instant initials recognition, and durable micro-size fidelity across browser extensions, CLI tools, and web dashboards.
